verses.ar: يَا ٱبْنِي، لَا تَنْسَ شَرِيعَتِي، بَلْ لِيَحْفَظْ قَلْبُكَ وَصَايَايَ.
verses.kjv: My son, forget not my law; but let thine heart keep my commandments:
verses.web: My son, don’t forget my teaching, but let your heart keep my commandments,

verses.ar: فَإِنَّهَا تَزِيدُكَ طُولَ أَيَّامٍ، وَسِنِي حَيَاةٍ وَسَلَامَةً.
verses.kjv: For length of days, and long life, and peace, shall they add to thee.
verses.web: for they will add to you length of days, years of life, and peace.

verses.ar: لَا تَدَعِ ٱلرَّحْمَةَ وَٱلْحَقَّ يَتْرُكَانِكَ. تَقَلَّدْهُمَا عَلَى عُنُقِكَ. اُكْتُبْهُمَا عَلَى لَوْحِ قَلْبِكَ،
verses.kjv: Let not mercy and truth forsake thee: bind them about thy neck; write them upon the table of thine heart:
verses.web: Don’t let kindness and truth forsake you. Bind them around your neck. Write them on the tablet of your heart.

verses.ar: فَتَجِدَ نِعْمَةً وَفِطْنَةً صَالِحَةً فِي أَعْيُنِ ٱللهِ وَٱلنَّاسِ.
verses.kjv: So shalt thou find favour and good understanding in the sight of God and man.
verses.web: So you will find favor, and good understanding in the sight of God and man.

verses.ar: تَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱلرَّبِّ بِكُلِّ قَلْبِكَ، وَعَلَى فَهْمِكَ لَا تَعْتَمِدْ.
verses.kjv: ¶ Trust in the LORD with all thine heart; and lean not unto thine own understanding.
verses.web: Trust in Yahweh with all your heart, and don’t lean on your own understanding.

verses.ar: فِي كُلِّ طُرُقِكَ ٱعْرِفْهُ، وَهُوَ يُقَوِّمُ سُبُلَكَ.
verses.kjv: In all thy ways acknowledge him, and he shall direct thy paths.
verses.web: In all your ways acknowledge him, and he will make your paths straight.

verses.ar: لَا تَكُنْ حَكِيمًا فِي عَيْنَيْ نَفْسِكَ. ٱتَّقِ ٱلرَّبَّ وَٱبْعُدْ عَنِ ٱلشَّرِّ،
verses.kjv: ¶ Be not wise in thine own eyes: fear the LORD, and depart from evil.
verses.web: Don’t be wise in your own eyes. Fear Yahweh, and depart from evil.

verses.ar: فَيَكُونَ شِفَاءً لِسُرَّتِكَ، وَسَقَاءً لِعِظَامِكَ.
verses.kjv: It shall be health to thy navel, and marrow to thy bones.
verses.web: It will be health to your body, and nourishment to your bones.

verses.ar: أَكْرِمِ ٱلرَّبَّ مِنْ مَالِكَ وَمِنْ كُلِّ بَاكُورَاتِ غَلَّتِكَ،
verses.kjv: Honour the LORD with thy substance, and with the firstfruits of all thine increase:
verses.web: Honor Yahweh with your substance, with the first fruits of all your increase;

verses.ar: فَتَمْتَلِئَ خَزَائِنُكَ شِبْعًا، وَتَفِيضَ مَعَاصِرُكَ مِسْطَارًا.
verses.kjv: So shall thy barns be filled with plenty, and thy presses shall burst out with new wine.
verses.web: so your barns will be filled with plenty, and your vats will overflow with new wine.

verses.ar: يَا ٱبْنِي، لَا تَحْتَقِرْ تَأْدِيبَ ٱلرَّبِّ وَلَا تَكْرَهْ تَوْبِيخَهُ،
verses.kjv: ¶ My son, despise not the chastening of the LORD; neither be weary of his correction:
verses.web: My son, don’t despise Yahweh’s discipline, neither be weary of his correction;

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلَّذِي يُحِبُّهُ ٱلرَّبُّ يُؤَدِّبُهُ، وَكَأَبٍ بِٱبْنٍ يُسَرُّ بِهِ.
verses.kjv: For whom the LORD loveth he correcteth; even as a father the son [in whom] he delighteth.
verses.web: for whom Yahweh loves, he corrects, even as a father reproves the son in whom he delights.

verses.ar: طُوبَى لِلْإِنْسَانِ ٱلَّذِي يَجِدُ ٱلْحِكْمَةَ، وَلِلرَّجُلِ ٱلَّذِي يَنَالُ ٱلْفَهْمَ،
verses.kjv: ¶ Happy [is] the man [that] findeth wisdom, and the man [that] getteth understanding.
verses.web: Happy is the man who finds wisdom, the man who gets understanding.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ تِجَارَتَهَا خَيْرٌ مِنْ تِجَارَةِ ٱلْفِضَّةِ، وَرِبْحَهَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ ٱلذَّهَبِ ٱلْخَالِصِ.
verses.kjv: For the merchandise of it [is] better than the merchandise of silver, and the gain thereof than fine gold.
verses.web: For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.

verses.ar: هِيَ أَثْمَنُ مِنَ ٱلَّلآلِئِ، وَكُلُّ جَوَاهِرِكَ لَا تُسَاوِيهَا.
verses.kjv: She [is] more precious than rubies: and all the things thou canst desire are not to be compared unto her.
verses.web: She is more precious than rubies. None of the things you can desire are to be compared to her.

verses.ar: فِي يَمِينِهَا طُولُ أَيَّامٍ، وَفِي يَسَارِهَا ٱلْغِنَى وَٱلْمَجْدُ.
verses.kjv: Length of days [is] in her right hand; [and] in her left hand riches and honour.
verses.web: Length of days is in her right hand. In her left hand are riches and honor.

verses.ar: طُرُقُهَا طُرُقُ نِعَمٍ، وَكُلُّ مَسَالِكِهَا سَلَامٌ.
verses.kjv: Her ways [are] ways of pleasantness, and all her paths [are] peace.
verses.web: Her ways are ways of pleasantness. All her paths are peace.

verses.ar: هِيَ شَجَرَةُ حَيَاةٍ لِمُمْسِكِيهَا، وَٱلْمُتَمَسِّكُ بِهَا مَغْبُوطٌ.
verses.kjv: She [is] a tree of life to them that lay hold upon her: and happy [is every one] that retaineth her.
verses.web: She is a tree of life to those who lay hold of her. Happy is everyone who retains her.

verses.ar: ٱلرَّبُّ بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ أَسَّسَ ٱلْأَرْضَ. أَثْبَتَ ٱلسَّمَاوَاتِ بِٱلْفَهْمِ.
verses.kjv: The LORD by wisdom hath founded the earth; by understanding hath he established the heavens.
verses.web: By wisdom Yahweh founded the earth. By understanding, he established the heavens.

verses.ar: بِعِلْمِهِ ٱنْشَقَّتِ ٱللُّجَجُ، وَتَقْطُرُ ٱلسَّحَابُ نَدًى.
verses.kjv: By his knowledge the depths are broken up, and the clouds drop down the dew.
verses.web: By his knowledge, the depths were broken up, and the skies drop down the dew.

verses.ar: يَا ٱبْنِي، لَا تَبْرَحْ هَذِهِ مِنْ عَيْنَيْكَ. ٱحْفَظِ ٱلرَّأْيَ وَٱلتَّدْبِيرَ،
verses.kjv: ¶ My son, let not them depart from thine eyes: keep sound wisdom and discretion:
verses.web: My son, let them not depart from your eyes. Keep sound wisdom and discretion,

verses.ar: فَيَكُونَا حَيَاةً لِنَفْسِكَ، وَنِعْمَةً لِعُنُقِكَ.
verses.kjv: So shall they be life unto thy soul, and grace to thy neck.
verses.web: so they will be life to your soul, and grace for your neck.

verses.ar: حِينَئِذٍ تَسْلُكُ فِي طَرِيقِكَ آمِنًا، وَلَا تَعْثُرُ رِجْلُكَ.
verses.kjv: Then shalt thou walk in thy way safely, and thy foot shall not stumble.
verses.web: Then you shall walk in your way securely. Your foot won’t stumble.

verses.ar: إِذَا ٱضْطَجَعْتَ فَلَا تَخَافُ، بَلْ تَضْطَجِعُ وَيَلُذُّ نَوْمُكَ.
verses.kjv: When thou liest down, thou shalt not be afraid: yea, thou shalt lie down, and thy sleep shall be sweet.
verses.web: When you lie down, you will not be afraid. Yes, you will lie down, and your sleep will be sweet.

verses.ar: لَا تَخْشَى مِنْ خَوْفٍ بَاغِتٍ، وَلَا مِنْ خَرَابِ ٱلْأَشْرَارِ إِذَا جَاءَ.
verses.kjv: Be not afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it cometh.
verses.web: Don’t be afraid of sudden fear, neither of the desolation of the wicked, when it comes;

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ يَكُونُ مُعْتَمَدَكَ، وَيَصُونُ رِجْلَكَ مِنْ أَنْ تُؤْخَذَ.
verses.kjv: For the LORD shall be thy confidence, and shall keep thy foot from being taken.
verses.web: for Yahweh will be your confidence, and will keep your foot from being taken.

verses.ar: لَا تَمْنَعِ ٱلْخَيْرَ عَنْ أَهْلِهِ، حِينَ يَكُونُ فِي طَاقَةِ يَدِكَ أَنْ تَفْعَلَهُ.
verses.kjv: ¶ Withhold not good from them to whom it is due, when it is in the power of thine hand to do [it].
verses.web: Don’t withhold good from those to whom it is due, when it is in the power of your hand to do it.

verses.ar: لَا تَقُلْ لِصَاحِبِكَ: «ٱذْهَبْ وَعُدْ فَأُعْطِيَكَ غَدًا» وَمَوْجُودٌ عِنْدَكَ.
verses.kjv: Say not unto thy neighbour, Go, and come again, and to morrow I will give; when thou hast it by thee.
verses.web: Don’t say to your neighbor, “Go, and come again; tomorrow I will give it to you,” when you have it by you.

verses.ar: لَا تَخْتَرِعْ شَرًّا عَلَى صَاحِبِكَ، وَهُوَ سَاكِنٌ لَدَيْكَ آمِنًا.
verses.kjv: Devise not evil against thy neighbour, seeing he dwelleth securely by thee.
verses.web: Don’t devise evil against your neighbor, since he dwells securely by you.

verses.ar: لَا تُخَاصِمْ إِنْسَانًا بِدُونِ سَبَبٍ، إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ قَدْ صَنَعَ مَعَكَ شَرًّا.
verses.kjv: ¶ Strive not with a man without cause, if he have done thee no harm.
verses.web: Don’t strive with a man without cause, if he has done you no harm.

verses.ar: لَا تَحْسِدِ ٱلظَّالِمَ وَلَا تَخْتَرْ شَيْئًا مِنْ طُرُقِهِ،
verses.kjv: ¶ Envy thou not the oppressor, and choose none of his ways.
verses.web: Don’t envy the man of violence. Choose none of his ways.

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلْمُلْتَوِيَ رَجْسٌ عِنْدَ ٱلرَّبِّ، أَمَّا سِرُّهُ فَعِنْدَ ٱلْمُسْتَقِيمِينَ.
verses.kjv: For the froward [is] abomination to the LORD: but his secret [is] with the righteous.
verses.web: For the perverse is an abomination to Yahweh, but his friendship is with the upright.

verses.ar: لَعْنَةُ ٱلرَّبِّ فِي بَيْتِ ٱلشِّرِّيرِ، لَكِنَّهُ يُبَارِكُ مَسْكَنَ ٱلصِّدِّيقِينَ.
verses.kjv: ¶ The curse of the LORD [is] in the house of the wicked: but he blesseth the habitation of the just.
verses.web: Yahweh’s curse is in the house of the wicked, but he blesses the habitation of the righteous.

verses.ar: كَمَا أَنَّهُ يَسْتَهْزِئُ بِٱلْمُسْتَهْزِئِينَ، هَكَذَا يُعْطِي نِعْمَةً لِلْمُتَوَاضِعِينَ.
verses.kjv: Surely he scorneth the scorners: but he giveth grace unto the lowly.
verses.web: Surely he mocks the mockers, but he gives grace to the humble.

verses.ar: ٱلْحُكَمَاءُ يَرِثُونَ مَجْدًا وَٱلْحَمْقَى يَحْمِلُونَ هَوَانًا.
verses.kjv: The wise shall inherit glory: but shame shall be the promotion of fools.
verses.web: The wise will inherit glory, but shame will be the promotion of fools.
